sourceChecks.title: Vitório, E. (2013). As construções existenciais com ter e haver: o que tem na fala e o que há na escrita
sourceChecks.finding: Study compares existential ter/haver in speech and academic writing; supports modality-sensitive variation but not all impersonal verbs or every agreement example.

sourceChecks.title: Carvalho & Oliveira, “Personal and impersonal verbs: from esse to ‘haver’ denoting existence”
sourceChecks.finding: Studies impersonal/existential haver; it does not by itself cover weather verbs or every present-tense example in the entry.

sourceChecks.title: Franchi, Negrão, & Viotti, Sobre a gramática das orações impessoais com ter/haver
sourceChecks.finding: Analyzes spoken Brazilian Portuguese existential ter/haver and treats existential sentences as impersonal constructions; does not cover meteorological verbs or every agreement pattern in the article.
